question: Which of the following conversions are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __Option 1__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 1L = 1 dm³__ and __1mL = 1 cm³__ are correct.
 
• 1 liter (L) is equivalent to 1 cubic decimeter (dm³).
 
• 1 milliliter (mL) is equivalent to 1 cubic centimeter (cm³).
 
• These conversions are widely used in scientific and mathematical contexts.
 
• Other options in the question incorrectly represent the relationships between liters, milliliters, cubic decimeters, and cubic centimeters.
